question: is the book's growth spread over its bars, or carried by a handful? priced with drop-best arms against a random-drop placebo

sibling_face.note: the sibling publishes NAV to its own cutoff; a headline difference is either the extra bars this face has or a second implementation -- the bar-level diff separates the two

notes: bars are the production book's own daily nav returns; nothing is re-simulated for the deterministic arms
random-drop placebo uses a fixed seed per k so the percentile is reproducible
growth shares use log returns, so the pieces add up to the whole
a book that survives losing its best 10 bars is a book; one that does not is a jackpot that already paid

verdict.why: the 10 best bars are only 6% of the up-move and the book keeps 57% of its cagr without its 10 best bars
